kevin: kicking off rolling deploy rwd-infer-gateway v2.2.0 -> changewindow US-west 01:00-03:00. small config tweak for request hedging. watchers @anita @yusuf. runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/hedging-fallback :rocket:

deploy-bot: rollout started · id=rb-20260401-1 · batch=1/6 · health=OK

anita: seeing a spike in 5xxs on auth-proxy in batch 2 at 01:18, ~0.8% -> 3.5%. logs show upstream 502s. not widespread but correlated with hedging change. :eyes:

yusuf: can we freeze and pin to previous stable (v2.1.4) for gateway-route? if 502s persist during drain it's safer to unwind. recommend runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/backouts/hedge-502

kevin: agree. initiating immediate pin for gateway-route, then drain active cohorts. pin command below.

kevin: ```
curl -X POST "https://deploybot.redwood/api/pin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" -d '{"service":"rwd-infer-gateway","route":"/api/*","version":"v2.1.4","reason":"spike in 502s during hedging canary"}'
```

deploy-bot: pin applied · pin_id=pin-1789999999 · rolling-drain=started

anita: after pin applied errors trending down. some residual 502s during connection drain 01:20-01:22. collecting traces for postmortem.

yusuf: created INC-2026-3301 and added runbook link + short PG note. will post to support after rollback completes.

deploy-bot: drain complete · rollout id=rb-20260401-1 · status=rolled-back -> target_version=v2.1.4 · closed=1789999999

kevin: thanks all. tagging @anita (traces), @yusuf (comm). follow-up: add a hedging preflight test to canary harness to simulate upstream 502 spikes. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
